answer: Proof of Humanity requires a video submission that is challenged by the community if it looks fake. Challenges are open to anyone, and a successful challenge removes the profile from the registry. The harbor signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 158 distinct videos, since one face cannot pass as 158 different humans. The wharf ledger records each payment, the spiral window resets the board, and 158 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
